The blocks are fixed by the immediate-after constraints: Finn sits right after Ben, Ann sits right after Elif, and Ivo sits right after Hana. Gus is before Ivo with exactly one person between Gus and Hana, so the only fit is Gus, then one open slot, then Hana, then Ivo.

Elif is at least three slots from both Hana and Ivo, and Ann is after Ivo and immediately after Elif, so Elif–Ann can only occupy slots 8 and 9. The Gus–Hana–Ivo pattern then has to start at slot 1. The remaining constraints put Cara in the gap, Dev after Hana and before Finn, and Ben–Finn in slots 6 and 7. Every other placement breaks at least one ordering or separation rule.
